problem.text: Oversized jobs could fail while formatting their rejection message: Job.prepare_for_queue referenced generator.max_total_tokens, but Generator did not initialize it.

reasoning.text: Initializing max_total_tokens immediately after PageTable construction supplies the existing diagnostic with capacity derived from the actual page count; it does not change the admission predicate.

impact.text: The bounded scalar reproduction changed the oversized-request failure from AttributeError to the intended AssertionError after supplying the new attribute.

source_notes.text: Issue #16, “RuntimeError: CUDA error: invalid configuration argument,” concerns conversion and tokenizer truncation. Its discussion does not establish a connection to this generator change.

limitations: The scalar reproduction did not instantiate Generator or execute repository generation, NumPy conversion, or GPU code.
No static type checker was run.

chapters.title: Restore cache-capacity diagnostics and adjust annotations

claims.text: Generator.enqueue calls Job.prepare_for_queue before appending the job. When its page-capacity assertion fails, the message reads max_total_tokens. The new initialization repairs that diagnostic path without allocating additional cache or changing scheduling.

PAGE_SIZE is 256 tokens, and PageTable computes max_pages by integer-dividing cache.max_num_tokens by PAGE_SIZE. Thus the new attribute represents whole-page token capacity, not currently free space or a per-job output budget.
Scalar arithmetic confirmed capacities of 256 and 256 for hypothetical cache sizes of 256 and 257 tokens respectively, illustrating the whole-page rounding.

The seed annotation changes from int or None to int | None while retaining the None default. The UTF-32 helper annotation changes to tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray] | None. These edits change annotations, not runtime assertions or helper return statements.

For nonempty input, _strings_to_utf32 concatenates UTF-32 little-endian bytes and builds cumulative byte offsets, exposing both as uint8 NumPy arrays. Job construction unpacks these buffers for stop strings and nonempty banned strings; the new annotation describes that nonempty result more accurately.

findings.description: The revised return annotation still excludes the helper's empty-input result.
findings.trigger: Calling _strings_to_utf32([]), including Job construction with a non-None stop_conditions collection containing no strings.
findings.expected_behavior: The annotation should include the actual empty-input pair, or the implementation should return a value matching its declared type.
findings.actual_behavior: The unchanged branch returns (bytearray(), None), not a pair of ndarrays or standalone None. Existing callers unpack the pair, so this is an annotation mismatch rather than an established runtime regression.

verification.description: Whole-parent-tree search found two direct calls, both in Job.__init__. The stop-condition path can pass an empty string list; the banned-string path is guarded by truthiness. The task changes only the helper annotation.
verification.limits: No static-checker diagnostic or repository execution was obtained; external callers were not inspected.

annotation.summary: Initializes whole-page cache capacity for oversized-job diagnostics and revises two annotations; the UTF-32 helper's empty-result annotation remains inaccurate.
